notes: Step 1 parts were correct; no parts added or dropped.
Circuit path: Uno pin 13 -> orange wire -> column 3 -> 220 ohm resistor -> column 6 -> LED anode (long, bent leg). LED cathode (column 8) -> black wire -> Uno GND.
In the image the breadboard half that holds the components is labelled rows f-j. The catalogue calls that half bank 'b' (rows f-j), so holes are written like '6b.i'.

Read from the image: resistor leads in 3b.h and 6b.h, LED legs in 6b.i (anode) and 8b.i (cathode), orange wire end in 3b.g, black wire end in 8b.g. Each column-bank strip joins its five holes, so the wire ends share a strip with the resistor lead (column 3) and the LED cathode (column 8).
The black ground wire goes to the GND pin next to pin 13 and AREF on the Uno header, which is GND.1 in the catalogue.
The LED and 220 ohm resistor are marked optional in the manual but are drawn in the circuit and schematic, so they are included.
The USB cable to the computer is not drawn, so it is not included.
